Figure 1: Economic Sector Performance and Housing Market Dynamics


 Graph A depicts the economic sector performance over time. The X-axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2021, and is measured in whole years. The Y-axis, without a clearly visible label, suggests a measurement of economic output or a similar metric, likely in units of billions (as suggested by observation of the label "...), and the numerical range from 200 to 280. The plotted line indicates that economic performance has been on a generally increasing trend, starting at a lower point in 2012 and reaching its peak in 2021. Notable points on the line include the start and end years, with the highest point at 2021, and other intermediate points indicating changes over the years.


 Graph B illustrates the percentage of new housing starts. The X-axis, labeled "городни (годинi)", seems to represent the year, with similar intervals from 2012 to 2021. The Y-axis, labeled with "% женщины", represents the percentage of female residents, ranging from approximately 0.5% to the peak of around 6.0%. The line in Graph B shows a downward trend from 2012 to around 2015, followed by significant volatility with sharp increases and decreases. The final years, post-2020, see a continuation of this fluctuation, eventually leading towards a higher percentage in 2021. The most significant points, including the years and the corresponding percentages, match those on the X-axis.


 Graph C shows a separate measure related to economic or housing dynamics, with the X-axis labeled "следства азартного игры" and a Y-axis marked “ -”. The year range is the same, from 2012 to 2021, and the line veers sharply downward. There are specific, clearly indicated points at the start and end years, 2012 and 2021, showing marked changes over the 10-year span. A steady rise is seen from the initial value, with notches and peaks throughout the graph, concluding with a steep increase in the final year.
